page.overview:
Who is Black Jack Tarr?

Black Jack Tarr is an enemy of Fu Manchu who fought a long war against him alongside Shang-Chi.

Black Jack Tarr was an ex soldier. He joined Shang-Chi, Sir Denis Nayland Smith, Petrie and Clive Reston in the war against Fu Manchu.
